name: Hunmin-397B-A17B-CUA
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA plus gated linear attention: 45 of 60 layers are linear_attention and 15 are full_attention, one every fourth layer
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 396.802 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-07.

benchmarks.name: OSWorld (360)
benchmarks.config: Card '### Computer-Use Agents' table '| Benchmark | Base | Hunmin (ours) | Qwen-CUA |': OSWorld (360) 48.2 base vs 70.5 Hunmin. All agent evals use image_max=5; baselines author-reproduced in the authors' environment, not copied from provider reports. Card warns these are not comparable to runs with image_max approx 20.

benchmarks.name: WindowsAgentArena (153)
benchmarks.config: Same table: base 41.8 vs Hunmin 50.9. image_max=5, author-reproduced baselines.

benchmarks.config: GUI-grounding table '| Benchmark | Base | **Hunmin (ours)** | Qwen-CUA |': 79.2 vs 86.8. Author-reproduced baselines.

benchmarks.name: ScreenSpot-Pro (zoom-in)
benchmarks.config: Same table, zoom-in setting: base 75.1 vs 76.6.

benchmarks.name: IFEval-Ko
benchmarks.config: Korean table '| Benchmark | Base | Hunmin (ours) | Qwen-CUA |': IFEval-Ko 84.7 base vs 85.1. Korean retention is close but not uniform: the base still wins KMMLU-Pro (77.9 vs 76.1) and K-MMStar (81.1 vs 80.3), and K-MMBench ties at 92.5.
